title: AutoThinkSQL：面向Text-to-SQL的动态推理学习框架
summary: 提出AutoThinkSQL框架，通过SFT和DPO集成自动思考机制，使模型能根据查询复杂度动态选择是否进行深度推理。在Spider和BIRD基准上取得一致提升，同时减少24.6%和18.3%的输出token，降低17.1%和11.5%的延迟。
summary_en: Proposes AutoThinkSQL, a framework integrating an auto-thinking mechanism into SFT and DPO for Text-to-SQL, enabling dynamic reasoning decisions based on query complexity. Achieves consistent gains on Spider and BIRD benchmarks while reducing output tokens by 24.6% and 18.3% and latency by 17.1% and 11.5% compared to CoT-only.
